spans.s: स्कद् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. स्कंदते) 1. To jump; 2. to raise; 3. to pour out.

स्कंद् vt. or vi. 1P (pp. स्कन्न; pres. स्कंदति) 1. To jump; 2. to jump upwards, to ascend; 3. to burst out; 4. to fall, to drop, Bt.xxii.11; 5. to perish, M.vii.84.With अव-, to assail, to besiege, पुरीमवस्कंद लुनीहि नंदनम् Sis.i.51.With आ-, to assail, stored, न तानगणयन् सर्वानास्कंदंश्च रिपून् द्विषः Bt.xvii.11.With परि-, to spring about, मेघनादः परिस्कंदन् परिष्कंदंतमाश्वरिम् Bt.ix.75.With प्र-, to spring forward.
स्कंद् Caus. (स्कंदयति-ते) to emit (as the seminal fluid), एकः शयीत सर्वत्र न रेतः स्कंदयेत् क्वचित् M.ii.180.
स्कंद् (II) vt. 10U (pres. स्कंदयति-ते)) To collect.
स्कंद m. 1. An epithet of Kārtikeya, यो हेमकुंभस्तननिःसृतानां स्कंदस्य मातुः पयसां रसज्ञः R.ii.36; 2. a king; 3. the body; 4. the bank of a river; 5. a clever man.
स्कांद (I) a. (f. दी) 1. Relating to Skanda; 2. relating to Śiva.
स्कांद (II) n. The Skanda-Purāṇa.
स्कंद-पुराण n. one of the 18 Purāṇas.
स्कंद-षष्ठी f. a festival in honour of Kārtikeya on the sixth day of Chaitra.
स्कंदक m. 1. One who leaps; 2. a soldier.
स्कंदन n. 1. Emission, effusion; 2. purging, looseness; 3. going, moving; 4. drying up; 5. the suppression of bleeding by cold applications.
स्कंध् vt. 10U (स्कंधयति-ते) To collect.

स्कंध m. 1. The shoulder; 2. the body; 3. the trunk of a tree, खर्जूरिस्कंधनद्धानां मदोद्गारसुगंधिषु R.iv.57; 4. a branch, a branch of human knowledge; 5. a book, a chapter; 6. the five objects of sense; 7. the five forms of mundane consciousness (in Buddhistic works), सर्वकार्यशरीरेषु मुक्त्वांगस्कंधपंचकम् Sis.ii.28; 8. a road; 9. detachment of an army; 10. war; 11. a multitude; 12. an agreement; 13. a king; 14. a wise or learned man; 15. a heron.
स्कंध-आवार m. 1. an army; 2. a royal capital; 3. a camp.
स्कंध-उपानेय (I) a. to be carried on the shoulders.
स्कंध-उपानेय (II) m. a form of peace-offering in which fruit or grain is presented as a mark of submission.
स्कंध-चाप m. a sort of yoke for carrying burdens.
स्कंध-तरु m. the cocoanut tree.
स्कंध-देश m. the shoulder, इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रंथिना स्कंधदेशे Sak.i.
स्कंध-निर्वाण n. the annihilation of the elements of being, (with Buddhists).
स्कंध-फल m. 1. the cocoanut tree; 2. the Bilva tree.
स्कंध-बंधना f. a sort of fennel.
स्कंध-मल्लक m. a heron.
स्कंध-रुह m. the Indian fig tree.
स्कंध-वाह, -वाहक m. an ox trained to carry burdens, a pack-bullock.
स्कंध-वाह, -वाहक m. an ox trained to carry burdens, a pack-bullock.
स्कंध-शाखा f. a principal branch (i.e. the forked branch) which issues from the upper stem of a tree.
स्कंध-शृंग m. a buffalo.
स्कंध-स्कंध m. every shoulder.
स्कंधस् n. 1. The shoulder; 2. the trunk of a tree.
स्कंधिक m. An ox trained to carry burdens.
स्कंधिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having shoulders; 2. having branches.
स्कंधिन् (II) n. A tree.
स्कंधिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having shoulders; 2. having branches.
स्कन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Fallen down, descended; 2. oozed out, trickled down; 3. emitted, sprinkled; 4. gone; 5. dried up.
स्कन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Fallen down, descended; 2. oozed out, trickled down; 3. emitted, sprinkled; 4. gone; 5. dried up.
स्कंभ् vt. 1Ā, 5P, 9P (pres. स्कंभते, स्कभ्नोति, स्कभ्नाति) 1. To create; 2. to stop, to hinder, to impede, to restrain.
स्कंभ् Caus. (स्कभ्नाति-ते or स्कंभयति-ते) With वि-, to impede, to obstruct.
स्कंभ m. 1. Support, prop; 2. the supreme being.
स्कंभन n. The act of supporting, support.
स्कांद (I) a. (f. दी) 1. Relating to Skanda; 2. relating to Śiva.
